hints.title: Sorted Array Partitioning
hints.text: The array is partitioned into negative values, zeros, and positive values.

hints.title: Zero Boundaries
hints.text: Find the index of the first zero and the index of the first positive value.

hints.title: Direct Count Comparison
hints.text: Negatives end before zero, and positives start after zero. Compare the two counts.

hints.title: Bisection Boundary Search Implementation

complexity.notes: Two logarithmic bisection searches locating zero thresholds.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear counting takes O(n), ignoring the non-decreasing sorted property.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses bisection search over sorted array to achieve sublinear time.
